name: Shock-Wave Zither (Chấn Ba Cầm)

arts.name: Resonant Shockwave (Cộng Chấn Ba)
arts.rule: Counts as a Hollow Tide Scripture art. A quick Force wave that lays 1 Qi Disruption. Each Force burn tick you deal adds a Drink (once a pulse), so the zither feeds the scripture's Draining Gulp and Hollowing Strike.

lore: A short zither strung with hollow reed; one plucked string makes a stone ring and then crack.
build_use: Hollow Tide Scripture builds (the Qi Drinker): a cheap fourth scripture art that lays Disruption, adds Drink and counts for Siphon Palm's same-pulse step.

name: Hollow Ring (Không Giới)
lore: A band of grey metal with nothing set in its bezel. It weighs less than it should.
build_use: Any Chaos-damage curse build (the Night Plague, the Ruin Ledger curse stacker): longer statuses, stronger debuffs, a little Chaos damage.

name: Hollow Robe (Không Y)

wards.name: Hollow Veil (Không Sa)
wards.notes: The starter robe's ward at 1.2 of its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.788 of 3.813)

lore: A robe cut from cloth that was never dyed or woven, only pressed. Blows slide off it like wind off a bowl.
build_use: The Hundred Arts Sage and the Unmaker: light armour with Force cover and Chaos resistance, leaving thần thức for treasures.

name: Ledger-Murmur Pendant (Phế Thanh Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Murmuring Debts (Thì Thầm Nợ)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, the statuses you land last 8 % longer and your Chaos hits deal 5 % more, so every curse stays on the books a little longer.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (8.1 W)

lore: Black jade that hums a count of numbers when held to the ear; accountants of the Ruin Ledger lineage wear it.
build_use: Curse builds on the Ruin Ledger Scripture: a standing, slot-free lengthening of every status they land, which keeps Fray and distinct-status reads fed.

name: Ledger Branding Iron (Phế Trướng Lạc Thiết)
lore: An executioner's iron whose brand does not blister the skin but the name; each mark is another line in the ledger.
build_use: The Ruin Ledger curse stacker: every different status on the foe (Sundered, Exposed, Stagnation, Disruption) makes all its hits harder, on top of the scripture's own distinct-status reads.

name: Balance-Sheet Seal (Kết Toán Ấn)

arts.name: Settle the Account (Kết Toán)
arts.rule: Counts as a Ruin Ledger Scripture art. A slow Chaos seal that lays 1 Stagnation. Every status or stack batch you land adds a Fray for 12 s. With 5 Fray it spends them and the account is settled: 4.5 times as hard; a foe wearing 4 different statuses takes 3 times, and so does one hit by Ripening Curse in the last 4 s (2.8 times).

lore: The seal Ruin Ledger clerks stamp on a debt that can no longer be argued.
build_use: Ruin Ledger Scripture builds: a fourth suite art that Fraying Thread, the Verdict and Ripening Curse count, and a finisher that cashes the Fray they stack.

name: Hollow Bell (Không Chung)

wards.name: Muffled Bell (Muộn Chung Tráo)
wards.notes: The starter bell at 1.3 of its payload and its per-hit payment, so the price check is unchanged (3.019 of 3.050)

lore: A bell with no clapper. It rings only when struck, and the sound goes inward.
build_use: Boss fighters in the Chaos and Darkness builds (the Shadow Bargain, the Hundred Arts Sage): a heavier bell against slow hits, with the status resistance they need against cleansing and curse foes.

name: Ring of the Open Vein (Khai Mạch Giới)
lore: A ring with a thorn on the inside; it takes a drop each dawn and gives it back in the fight.
build_use: Bloodletting Rite users: the 4 % health the rite costs comes back through Blood Drinker, the leech and the health pool, and the rite's 6 s of leech stack on top.

name: Mirror of Primordial Chaos (Hỗn Nguyên Kính)

effects.name: Unmaking Glass (Hủy Nguyên Kính)
effects.rule: Each hit you land strips 1 buff stack from the target, from its largest pile, at most once a pulse. Each stack stripped counts as a status you landed, so it feeds your Fray and every read of the foe's distinct statuses.
effects.reads: Your hits landing, instant; the target's buff stacks
effects.payload: Removes 1 foe buff stack a pulse; counts as a status application
effects.closes: Your own buff stacks last 25 % shorter.
effects.from: variant-chaos.md, The Unmaker (its New piece Unmake, as an Effect)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

reserve_arts.name: Still Reflection (Tĩnh Ảnh)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, you resist the statuses and debuffs the enemy lays on you, as the mirror shows only what is.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W (8 W)

holder: An elder of a Chaos-root lineage at Nascent Soul or above; otherwise Lost in the ruins at the centre of the map
lore: A bronze mirror that reflects nothing; what it faces comes apart into the five things it was made of.
build_use: The Unmaker: strips the stack builds of every element and turns each stripped stack into a status for the Ruin Ledger's Fray and distinct-status reads; a Chaos-damage mirror for the Hundred Arts Sage.

name: Locket of the Last Bargain (Tuyệt Khế Bội)
holder: The keeper of the Shadow Shrine, or Lost in a sunken tomb on the Darkness island
lore: Inside it is a name signed in ink that is not ink. Its wearer has already paid; only the collecting is left.
build_use: The Shadow Bargain: Final Clause makes the Down step a last free Chaos art, the crit damage and the leech pay for the fight before it, and Darkness damage rides the rest.

name: Null Plate (Hư Giáp)

wards.name: Null Ward (Hư Tráo)
wards.notes: The Common Ward at 1.3 of its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050)

lore: Plate hammered from metal that rang wrong, so that it hums back at whatever strikes it and takes the sting out.
build_use: Builds that want heavier armour than the Hollow Robe: a standing drain ward that beats the Common Ward, with Force resistance and status resistance.
notes: Answers: art-thief: a heavier armour whose ward beats a Common Ward at ws 62.5

name: Draining Signet (Hấp Khí Giới)
lore: A ring of pale bone-grey metal; held near a lamp, the flame leans toward it.
build_use: Qi-burn and Disruption builds: Force damage, stronger Disruption stacks, and every tick also burns the foe's linh lực.
notes: Answers: art-thief: a Force-scoped ring with attack_pct; burial-shroud: a ring that raises Qi Disruption strength or the foe's linh lực drain

name: Ash-to-Void Pendant (Hôi Hư Bội)
lore: A jade flecked with soot; whatever burns near it leaves ash that is not ash but absence.
build_use: Fire-to-Chaos converters: a share of Fire damage turns to Chaos, and the Chaos that results cuts through resistance.
notes: Answers: triple-convert: a Fire-to-Chaos conversion piece (+30 to +50 % convert); triple-convert: Chaos penetration on a necklace

name: Seal of Foreclosure (Tịch Biên Ấn)

arts.name: Foreclose (Tịch Biên)
arts.rule: Counts as a Ruin Ledger Scripture art. A slow Chaos seal that lays 1 Sundered. Every status or stack batch you land adds a Fray for 12 s. With 4 Fray it spends them and forecloses: 2.4 times as hard; a foe wearing 4 different statuses takes 1.2 times.

holder: The ledger-master of a Chaos-root sect; otherwise Lost in the ruins at the centre of the map
lore: The seal that closes a book for good. What it stamps is owed in blood.
build_use: Ruin Ledger curse stackers: a grade 4 scripture weapon that lays Sundered, cashes Fray sooner than the Balance-Sheet Seal, and shifts its art costs to health.
notes: Answers: burial-shroud: a grade 4 Ruin Ledger weapon; unique-chaos-last-bargain-locket: a grade 4 weapon of the family with health pay
